summary: fix(settings): split set password subscription heading in two
description:
## Because - An l10n reviewer asked if the combined heading could be two strings. - `set-password-subscription-heading-with-product` held `` markup inside one FTL string, so each translator had to keep the tag in place. - Screen readers read the heading and the product line as one phrase. ## This pull request - Removes `set-password-subscription-heading-with-product` from `en.ftl`. No other file uses the id. - Adds `set-password-subscription-subheading = Continue to { $productName }` for the product line. - Renders two `FtlMsg` blocks in `SetPassword/index.tsx`: the `h1` with `card-header`, and a sibling `

` when the link carries `product_name`. - Updates the tests. The `h1` name is now "Create a Mozilla account" alone, the subheading has its own assertion, and the case without `product_name` asserts that the subheading is absent. ## Issue that this pull request solves Closes: https://mozilla-hub.atlassian.net/browse/FXA-14380
